title: 皐月賞の後に・冠ゲット☆

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is the victor! She's emerged victorious in this showdown between the big three and the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Never thought I'd see you strike a victory pose…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ew! Quit staring, you perv! King Pervert!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha… You imbecile! Looking at the winner is perfectly normal behavior!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ahem… Congratulations, Sky. However, this is the last time I applaud you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For you will be the one congratulating me at the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: We'll see about that. There'll be another impressive contender there, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I almost forgot. Thanks for the applause, King Pervert.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You will stop calling me that disgraceful name immediately!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I won. ☆ Victory is mine! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thank you much. Maaan, I can't believe I got me that first crown though.
choice_data_list: Let's keep it up and get the second one!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wanna ride that wave, like, pretty bad, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just as much, I'd like to keep my feet on the sand… if you know what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says this quietly while looking off to the side toward…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week stares at Seiun Sky, her eyes ablaze, ready for any challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from the race…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment? There's something I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't tell me. Is this another declaration of war? Have you been hanging out too much with King?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I'm here to declare war.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And, um, congratulations! I always knew you were great.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But… I really don't wanna lose next time, in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gotta aim for that dream…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right. I wanna win the Derby and become the best Umamusume in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why the Derby will be mine! I'm gonna get better and better! Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Dreams, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I bet she really is gonna get stronger. Spe's got that main character energy, turning her hopes and dreams into her strength.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: To be honest, when I see her do that… it makes me want to see her accomplish those dreams.
choice_data_list: But then your dream won't come true.
But then your dream won't come true.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not saying I'm gonna let her win. It's just that I don't have some passion-filled motivation like—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There goes my phone…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Hello?

text_block_list.name: Caller
text_block_list.text: SKYYY! CONGRATULATIONS!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Gramps! Turn it down a notch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sky panics and promptly creates some distance for some privacy. Even from far away though, I can hear the incredible joy coming from the voice on the line.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What a pain… You'd think I'd already won the Triple Crown from that reaction.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, my good ol' Gramps. I mean, I get why he was so over the moon.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's his dream to see me win the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure is. He's been bugging me about it since I was a little kid!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Picture kneeling down to a sweet, innocent Umamusume child and saying, "You've got what it takes to win the Triple Crown." That's a lot.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can't reel in a big fish without putting your back into it. Maybe it's time to get serious, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think back to that rare moment when she spoke so earnestly. It seems her grandfather's dream is connected to her decision to compete in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, don't think I'm trying to win this just for him, okay? 'Cause I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm glad it's happening now though. Gramps isn't a spring chicken anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's good I can show him the races he always dreamt I would run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sky smiles softly. It's a touching moment, but as quickly as it came…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can't get rewarded for winning the Classics if he's not around to see it, am I right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's why I run—for me, myself and I.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not like Spe and the others… I don't have a beautiful dream or some deep reason to win.
choice_data_list: There's nothing wrong with just wanting to win.
There's nothing wrong with just wanting to win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You may be right, but don't say that out loud.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well… who cares anyway? Even a slacker like me…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can win the Japanese Derby!
